prompt:
Create one continuous eight-second cinematic architectural product shot connecting the exact supplied first frame to the exact supplied last frame.

The central structure is a monumental precision-machined physical realization of the Interlock geometry. Preserve its identity and symmetry. The environment is near-black and minimal with immense negative space. Materials are matte ivory ceramic-metal with subtle real surface texture, crisp hard edges, restrained specular highlights and genuine physical mass.

Two independent paired trajectories approach the same shared boundary with precise controlled movement. They are individually coherent but jointly constrained. As their coupling at the shared boundary becomes apparent, all motion stops completely.

Hold a clearly perceptible authorization pause of seven tenths of a second. During this beat the trajectories are stationary, the gate is stationary, and camera movement becomes nearly imperceptible.

Only after that pause may the gate change state.

The central gate then opens through physically plausible precision mechanics over roughly half a second, with a mechanical rather than organic easing. The gate must reach its fully authorized open state before either trajectory resumes.

Once fully open, both trajectories continue through the shared aperture together in synchronized controlled motion.

Camera: one continuous shot, no cuts. Begin with an intimate macro architectural perspective and perform an exceptionally slow, controlled dolly backward that gradually reveals the complete structure. Camera motion settles during the authorization pause and resumes subtly during passage.

Aesthetic: premium architectural product film, museum-grade industrial design cinematography, severe composition, monumental scale, deep blacks, controlled highlights, physically believable mechanics, restraint rather than spectacle.

Audio: extremely restrained low environmental tone, subtle material resonance during approach, one precise mechanical engagement at coupling, near silence during the authorization pause, then a soft precision-machined release when the gate opens. No music, narration, dialogue, electronic UI sounds, or trailer effects.

The video is a physical metaphor for evidence-bound coordination, not a depiction of robots or artificial-intelligence characters.

No generated text or typography.
